json.reasoning: The request is a single locked-camera observation of rain running down a bus window at night, with exactly two shots pinned by the caller, so the director note preferring three shots is overridden and the shot count stays at two. No reference manifest, frame anchors, replacements, dialogue, music, or visible lettering are supplied, so assets, dialogue, onscreen_text and replacement_targets are empty, and the prohibited music stays forbidden under a balanced creativity setting. Both shots are Static Shot with empty amplitude and speed because the camera is explicitly locked; only the framing and what the eye is given to see change across the cut, within the 8000 ms target. Sound is limited to diegetic ambience, not score.

shots.action: A locked camera holds on a bus window at night seen from inside the dark, mostly empty interior; rain streams down the outside of the glass in wavering threads, beads of water catching the blurred glow of streetlights and passing traffic beyond the pane, while the faint sheen of condensation creeps along the lower edge of the window and the city outside stays soft and out of focus.
sync_sound: soft rain pattering against the window
low muffled hum of the bus interior
shots.what_changes: The scene is established: the fixed view of the night bus window fills the frame and the rain begins its slow, irregular travel down the glass.

shots.action: The locked camera now holds on the same bus window in a tighter view, the glass filling most of the frame as individual droplets swell, merge and drag downward in uneven tracks, thin rivulets branching and rejoining while the out-of-focus night lights of the city smear and shift behind the wet pane and the condensation along the bottom grows slightly more opaque.
subjects: blurred night city lights beyond the pane
sync_sound: steady rain ticking on the glass
shots.what_changes: The view tightens onto the glass itself, so the droplets and their merging, branching downward runs become the subject instead of the wider interior around the window.
